subject: Re: Joint Marketplace + SI demo — scheduling and APAC-friendly slots
messages:
From: Miles Duncan <miles.duncan@skyline-systems.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Joint marketplace + SI demo with Redwood & AWS

Hi Irene —

Thanks for taking this. Skyline is preparing a customer-facing demo that showcases our SI integration with Redwood Inference in the AWS Marketplace listing. The customer (Horizon Tech APAC) is APAC-first and has asked for a session that works outside of their local business hours.

High level ask: can we coordinate a tri-party demo (Redwood product + Skyline implementation + a short AWS presence) that is friendly to APAC attendees? We expect ~30–45 people (mix of product and infra).

Constraints:
- They prefer the window between 10:00–14:00 JST on Thurs/Fri next week, or an early morning PST slot.
- Avoid Wed (Skyline run-of-week deployments).

Would appreciate proposed times and whether Redwood can do two staggered sessions (EMEA/US + APAC) if a single slot isn't possible.

Thanks — Miles
Miles Duncan
Partnerships, Skyline Systems
Attachment: customer-context.txt (plain text, 8 KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Miles Duncan <miles.duncan@skyline-systems.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Joint marketplace + SI demo with Redwood & AWS

Hi Miles —

Appreciate the context. Short answers up front: we can absolutely support an APAC-friendly session and splitting into two staggered runs is OK; we just need to lock an ops host and a technical lead for each slot.

Proposed slots (all listed in local times followed by UTC):
- Option A (APAC-friendly): Thu 2026-10-22 10:30 JST / Thu 01:30 UTC (best for APAC daytime)
- Option B (Early PST): Fri 2026-10-23 08:00 PDT / Fri 15:00 UTC (works for US West mornings and EMEA afternoon)
- Option C (Split approach): Thu 2026-10-22 02:00 PDT (Wed evening APAC) + Thu 2026-10-22 10:30 JST (separate technical deep-dive for APAC)

Notes:
- Vanessa can lead the solution demo; I can cover joint marketplace positioning and handle the integration Q&A.
- We have a short runbook and a proposed .ics with tentative invites attached — triage_runbook.pdf and proposed_slots.ics.
- Please confirm any hard blackout windows (e.g., AWS POCs or your deploy blackout on Wed).

Links: calendar poll / proposed slots: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-def456
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QwX-triage-runbook

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: triage_runbook.pdf (PDF, 420 KB); proposed_slots.ics (calendar invite)
From: Miles Duncan <miles.duncan@skyline-systems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 00:10:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Request: Joint marketplace + SI demo with Redwood & AWS

Karthik —

Thanks for the thoughtful options. Option A (Thu 10:30 JST) is our preferred time; Option C would be fine if we need a separate technical deep-dive for APAC engineers.

A couple of clarifications:
- Confirmed: avoid Wed due to our internal deploys.
- AWS can provide a short intro (10 mins) but cannot commit to a second follow-up session the same week.
- We do prefer Vanessa to host the demo portion.

Can Redwood confirm who will be the ops contact for the session and whether you can provide a short pre-demo checklist for network/keys? We also need a versioned binary or model artifact reference for the customer (even if it's a mock).

Appreciate it — will circulate to Horizon Tech once we have a firm time.

— Miles
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Miles Duncan <miles.duncan@skyline-systems.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 03:22:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Request: Joint marketplace + SI demo with Redwood & AWS

Thanks, Miles — and thanks Karthik for the proposals.

We will go with Option A: Thu 2026-10-22 10:30 JST. Action items and owners:
- Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com) — lead demo host and technical walkthrough; please prepare the short slide (5–7 slides) and confirm any infra pre-reqs.
- Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) — own positioning + marketplace CTA and intro.
- Irene Choi (me) — ops owner; I'll send the pre-demo checklist and a temporary access token procedure to Miles and the Horizon Tech team.

Pre-demo checklist (short):
1) Confirm attendee list and roles (product/infra).
2) Network whitelists for demo subnet (IP ranges) — see Drive link.
3) Short model artifact reference (we can provide a mock model id: redwood-demo-v2)
4) Test run 30 minutes prior with SI + customer.

I attached the triage runbook and a provisional .ics with the slot. Miles — please send AWS contact info for the 10-min intro so we can add them to the invite.

I will follow up with a single consolidated invite and a 30-min test-run calendar block.

Best —
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
